findings.current: Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung, fighting off their enemies while supporting the battered Jin Taekyung.
findings.defect: The draft transfers the stated injury from those supporting Taekyung to Taekyung himself.
findings.rationale: 성치 않은 몸으로 describes the condition of Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung as they support him.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung, wounded themselves, supporting Jin Taekyung as they fought off their enemies.
findings.source: 성치 않은 몸으로 진태경을 부축한 채 적들을 상대하던 적천강과 청풍도.

findings.current: Their hands gripped crude wooden spears and rusty axes with all their strength.
findings.defect: The spears are bamboo, not generically wooden.
findings.replacement: They gripped crude bamboo spears and rusty axes with all their strength.
findings.source: 조잡한 죽창과 녹이 슨 도끼를 온 힘을 다해 움켜쥔 채.

findings.current: The Blood Lord was genuinely baffled.
findings.defect: The draft loses what he is questioning: whether the civilians have lost their minds.
findings.rationale: 진심으로 의심했다 refers back to his accusation that they are 정신 나간 것들; the following sentence gives his reason.
findings.replacement: The Blood Lord genuinely wondered if they had lost their minds.
findings.source:
“이런…… 정신 나간 것들을 보았나.”

혈주는 진심으로 의심했다.

findings.current: Much like the feeling that had swept through him the instant he saw Taekyung’s condition.
findings.defect: The draft drops the comparison between the fanatics crumpling and his heart sinking at Taekyung’s condition.
findings.rationale: 마치 links 와르르 허물어진다 to his emotional reaction, not merely to a feeling that swept through him.
findings.replacement: Just as his heart had crumpled when he saw Taekyung’s condition.
findings.source: 마치, 진태경의 상태를 확인한 순간 느꼈던 그의 마음처럼.

findings.defect: The draft reveals the full command before Taekyung finishes saying it, losing the delayed punchline.
findings.rationale: The source first gives only the end of an indistinct command; 조용히 좀 해라 supplies its meaning in his next line.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it misattributes an injury, changes the civilians’ weapons, and loses two character beats.
